question: What is the meaning of bill of materials in relation to unique product identifiers, general information?
description: Bill of materials in relation to unique product identifiers and general information refers to a comprehensive list of all the materials, components, and sub-assemblies required to manufacture a product. It includes details such as product names, brand names, manufacturer details, registration numbers, country of registration, temporal information like manufacturing date and expected lifetime, as well as unique identifiers like GTIN or EAN numbers. This information is crucial for tracking and tracing materials and products throughout their lifecycle and ensuring transparency in the supply chain.
